title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1971-08-06
source: Matrix of SBD(96541) and AUD (94261) with PATCH AUD(88816)

ai_review.summary: A superb matrix recording of the August 6 1971 Hollywood Palladium show, delivering crystal‑clear sound and a performance fans deem a masterpiece.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers gush over the audio fidelity of Chris Chappell’s transfer, calling the mix fantastic and “not to be missed.”  The concert itself is described as a 1971 highlight that blows listeners away, with no noted flaws in performance or song selection.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently 5‑star praise for both the show and the recording; high energy, excellent matrix mix, and no reported issues lead to a near‑top rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers highlight a flawless, crystal‑clear mix and commend the Chappell transfer as sounding “like never before,” despite it not being a pure soundboard source.
